item_summary: $60-90 smart LED desk lamp with ambient light sensors for auto-dimming, adjustable color temperature, and an integrated wireless charging base
detailed_item_draft: Seek a smart LED desk lamp with a retail price point between $60 and $90. Core functionality must include built-in ambient light sensors enabling automatic brightness adjustment based on environmental conditions. Color temperature must be adjustable across a range of 2700K to 6500K, controllable via touch interface or smartphone application. The unit must feature a Qi-compatible wireless charging base capable of delivering at least 10W of power to compatible smartphones. Design specifications require an adjustable arm and head for ergonomic positioning, constructed from durable materials such as matte aluminum or high-grade plastic. Additional smart capabilities should include voice assistant compatibility (Amazon Alexa or Google Home) and memory function for preferred settings. Lighting quality must be certified flicker-free and low-glare for eye comfort. Power cable length should be a minimum of 1.5 meters (5 feet), with USB-C power input preferred for modern adaptability.
